Let me look at the source code for array indexing in the projection files. The vulnerability is about "array lookup with wrong indices due to missing validation before accessing the array". Let me search for array accesses in the projection source files.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/proj.4 && grep -rn "\[" src/PJ_*.c | grep -v "P->" | grep -v "argv\[" | grep -v "argc" | grep -v "\[0\]" | grep -v "\[1\]" | grep -v "\[2\]" | grep -v "\[3\]" | grep -v "\[4\]" | head -40</｜｜DSML｜｜>
